Adding technical context on SKUs and billing hooks.

- Meter types we propose: token-based (per-1k tokens), hourly committed capacity (vGPU-hour), and subscription monthly seats (per-seat/month) for support/console. Each SKU row in sku_matrix.xlsx maps to one meter.
- For GCP listing, we register metering details and a price per meter. GCP will surface an invoice to the buyer; Redwood receives payout via Marketplace settlement.
- For Net30/PO flows: we will accept PO + Net30 for the first purchase, but large enterprise deals may require a revenue holdback schedule in the listing. We'll coordinate with finance.
- SLOs & support tiers: recommend including a 'dedicated' SKU for customers requiring reserved capacity (Redwood Dedicated) — that SKU needs lead time (2-4 weeks).

Note: sku_matrix.xlsx contains the column "meter_id" that should be included on any PO line items to avoid mapping errors.

Diego Fernandez
GCP Listings Lead — Redwood Inference
